03 / A long-term vision

One team.
Every stage.

The pathway keeps developing young talent even as the senior programme progresses. Our target for 2028 is UCI Continental status.

01

Youth

Build foundations and introduce ambitious young riders to the racing pathway.

02

Junior

Develop race craft and consistency through a competitive national programme.

03

U23

Step up through national competition, European race blocks and targeted development.

04

Elite → Continental

A senior programme targeting UCI Continental status in 2028, supported by the development pathway.

2028

04 / Where SCI-MX fits

The work
between the races.

Training, racing, travel and recovery are part of everyday life for a development squad. Practical, consistent nutrition is an area where the partnership could make a difference.

Recover

Reliable post-session routines and protein options for riders building their training week after week.

Fuel consistently

Everyday nutrition riders can carry into a structured programme, not just something used on race day.

Support the journey

Accessible team nutrition for camps, travel blocks and demanding race calendars across the programme.

The SCI-MX range we'd fuel with
ProteinRecoveryEveryday nutritionTraining campsTravel
05 / The partnership

Start practical.
Grow together.

A straightforward 2027 commercial arrangement, with scope for a closer partnership as the programme moves towards 2028.

What we're asking for

Meaningful support for the 2027 season.

01
Preferential team & athlete pricing

A meaningful discount on SCI-MX protein, recovery and everyday nutrition.

02
Training-camp product support

Practical product provision for key team camps and European training or race blocks.

03
A partnership review before 2028

Agree what worked and explore a larger role as the Elite programme develops.

What SCI-MX receives · subject to agreement

Visibility with a credible development story.

01
Brand presence

Potential agreed placements across kit, vehicles and the team's digital channels.

02
Relevant race exposure

Coverage around planned UK Nationals, National Series and European racing, across men's and women's squads.

03
Rider-led content

Authentic photos and short-form content from training, camps and race days for agreed SCI-MX use.

04
Product feedback

Constructive feedback from athletes training and racing across different development stages.
